actions.reason: The K6_C0001/K6_C0004 boundary is the weakest and most conflicting in the partition. Boundary representation is essentially unexpressed in three of four native geometries (CT silhouette 0.029, RNA 0.023, WSI 0.001, with 33-42% negative silhouettes), with only WXS showing modest separation (0.251); the boundary is therefore not coherently represented across modalities. Boundary structure is likewise conflicting: although candidate-consensus ARI is high (0.889) with within-side affinity (0.429) exceeding between-side (0.226), the normalized-cut cost is high (0.720) indicating substantial cross-boundary connectivity, and the union eigengap profile is dominated by the single-cluster resolution (candidate_k=1, leading gap 0.637 vs next 0.128), a merge-compatible pattern. The two sets' transcriptomic phenotypes are not clearly opposing independent programs: K6_C0001 is proliferation-high/OXPHOS-low while K6_C0004 is immune-low/proliferation-low/TGF-beta-high, and both share down-regulated oxidative metabolism, so the union is consistent with a single unit rather than two well-separated ones. With the current boundary weak/conflicting and the union more consistent with one unit, merge is the supported provisional revision.
